findings.title: Concurrent-deletion NPE remains in other lazy-delegate accessors
findings.body: The fix null-checks modelSupplier.get() only in getSubGroupsCount(), but the same lazy delegate is dereferenced without a null check in getSubGroupsStream(String,Integer,Integer) at line 256, getSubGroupsStream(Integer,Integer) at line 262, and getSubGroupsStream(String,Boolean,Integer,Integer) at line 268. When another transaction deletes the group, LazyModel/getGroupById returns null exactly as in the getSubGroupsCount() case, so these methods still throw NullPointerException instead of handling the deleted group. The reported concurrent-access NPE therefore remains reachable through subgroup listing/search paths.

findings.title: Reader thread is never joined, making the new concurrency test racy and leaky
findings.body: The test starts a reader thread looping while deletedAll is false, then sets deletedAll=true at line 155 and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty at line 157 without joining the thread. An iteration already inside groups() can still add an exception after the assertion (false pass), or the still-running thread can leak into subsequent tests using the same managed realm/admin client and add failures there. The tight loop also hammers the server with no pause, so unrelated client/timeout errors can be collected unboundedly in the CopyOnWriteArrayList and make the test flaky. The thread should be stored, joined (with timeout) before asserting, and terminated in a finally block.
